papers.title: Optimization of Multi-Objective Process Parameters and Performance Analysis of High-Speed Laser Cladding of TC4/AISI431 Composite Coatings
papers.abstract: The authors of this paper investigated the process parameters of high-speed laser cladding of TC4/AISI431 composite coatings on the surface of C45 steel, choosing laser power, scanning speed, and TC4 addition as the experimental factors, and porosity, microhardness, and corrosion resistance as the target indices. A regression model was established based on the response surface methodology BBD, and the reliability of the model was analyzed using an ANOVA. Then, the WOA was used for multi-objective optimization. The optimal parameter set was determined as follows: a laser power of 5315 W, a scanning speed of 378 mm/s, and a TC4 addition of 3.6%. The microstructure and surface elemental composition of the coating were analyzed. The results showed that the porosity reduced by 60% and that the corrosion resistance improved by 79.98%, while the microhardness remained essentially unchanged.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究激光熔覆TC4/AISI431复合涂层的工艺优化与耐腐蚀性能，未提供Ti-6Al-4V的拉伸或疲劳力学数据。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not report tensile, yield, or fatigue strength; its mechanical characterization is limited to microhardness, and the primary focus is on corrosion resistance and porosity optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化高速激光熔覆TC4/AISI431复合涂层的工艺参数。
summary_zh.method: 采用响应面法和鲸鱼优化算法建立回归模型并多目标优化。
summary_zh.result: 最优参数下孔隙率降低60%，耐腐蚀性提升79.98%，显微硬度基本不变。
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观结构、表面成分和腐蚀实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to optimize the process parameters for high-speed laser cladding of TC4/AISI431 composite coatings to improve coating quality.
summary_en.method: A regression model was established using response surface methodology based on Box-Behnken design, and the whale optimization algorithm was employed for multi-objective optimization of porosity, microhardness, and corrosion resistance.
summary_en.result: Optimal parameters (laser power 5315 W, scanning speed 378 mm/s, TC4 addition 3.6%) reduced porosity by 60% and improved corrosion resistance by 79.98%, while microhardness remained nearly unchanged.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation included microstructure analysis, elemental composition, and corrosion tests confirming the optimization results.
